title: 第25章 一键简化外挂第26章 人善被人欺鬼善也被人欺
content_zh:
5000点功德啊，看来这皇族僵尸还是挺值钱的！
林道然看着眼前的火堆乐开了花，心里默念。
“系统，打开个人信息面板！”
宿主：林道然
天赋：天才
修为：人师九重（5000）
炼体：银体前期（100）
功法：上清大洞真经、茅山炼体术
术法：茅山初级符箓（3000）、茅山中级符箓（2500）、金光咒（大成2500）、闪电奔雷拳（大成1500）、请神术（小成4001000）
神通：无
外挂：十倍修炼速度增幅
功德点：（可消耗加载第二个外挂）
“嗯？系统，我可以加载第二个外挂了？那以后加载每个外挂都是一万点功德吗？”
【第二个外挂一万点功德即可加载！】
【后续外挂所需功德皆是上一个外挂的十倍！】
“啥？十倍？那第三个就是十万功德了，第四个百万……”
“我去哪找那么多的功德啊？怕是将世上所有的鬼怪抓空了，我都加载不了几个外挂！”
林道然一了解后续外挂的加载规律，便在心里吐槽道。
【宿主不必担心，系统既然敢开高价，那便有那么多的功德等宿主去获取！】
【是否消耗功德，加载外挂！】

“先不加载，等晚点再加载！”
回拒了系统加载请求的林道然，转身对着四目道长等人道。
“师叔，这僵尸看来已经被消灭了，要不我们先回去休息，等明天再来收尾了！”
看着已经逐渐熄灭的火堆，四目道长点点头，便让众人先回屋休息了！
……
“系统，快点，消耗功德加载第二个外挂！”
回到卧室的林道然搓了搓手，急不可耐地催促着系统加载外挂。
【功德-，成功加载：一键简化外挂】
【一键简化外挂：一切功法、技能、神通皆可简化，让你脱离学渣的烦恼，体验学神的快感！快速学习入门，简易提升熟练度！】
林道然看着简化外挂的介绍，目瞪狗呆，这一键简化外挂也太不讲理了吧！一切功法神通瞬间学会！再搭配十倍修炼！那不是一天一个圆满技能！只能说我林道然无敌了！
“系统，简化我身上的所有功法神通！”
【简化成功！】
【个人信息面板已更新！】
宿主：林道然
天赋：天才
修为：人师九重（4000）
炼体：银体前期（100）
功法：上清大洞真经（简化为：呼吸）、茅山炼体术（简化为：动弹）
术法：茅山符箓（3000简化为：书写）、金光咒（大成500简化为：晒太阳）、闪电奔雷拳（大成500简化为：触电）、请神术（小成4001000简化为：上香）
神通：无

外挂：十倍修炼速度增幅、一键简化
content_en:
5,000 merit points, it seems that this royal zombie is quite valuable!
Lin Daoran looked at the fire in front of him with joy and thought silently in his heart.
"System, open the personal information panel!"
Host: Lin Daoran
Talent: Genius
Cultivation level: ninth level of human teacher (5000)
Body Refining: Early Silver Body (100)
Kung Fu: Shangqing Dadong Zhenjing, Maoshan Body Refining Technique
Spells: Maoshan Elementary Talisman (3000), Maoshan Intermediate Talisman (2500), Golden Light Spell (Dacheng 2500), Lightning Thunder Fist (Dacheng 1500), Inviting God (Xiaocheng 4001000)
Supernatural powers: none
Plug-in: Ten times the cultivation speed increase
Merit points: (can be consumed to load a second plug-in)
"Huh? System, can I load a second plug-in? Then will each plug-in loaded in the future be worth 10,000 points of merit?"
[The second plug-in can be loaded with 10,000 points of merit! 】
[The merit required for subsequent plug-ins is ten times that of the previous plug-in! 】
"What? Ten times? Then the third one will be one hundred thousand merits, and the fourth one will be one million..."
"Where can I find so much merit? I'm afraid if I catch all the ghosts in the world, I won't be able to load a few plug-ins!"
As soon as Lin Daoran understood the loading rules of subsequent plug-ins, he complained in his heart.
[The host does not need to worry. Since the system dares to offer high prices, there are so many merits waiting for the host to obtain! 】
[Whether to consume merit and load plug-ins! 】
"Don't load it now, load it later!"
Lin Daoran, who rejected the system loading request, turned to Taoist Priest Simu and others.
"Uncle Master, it seems that this zombie has been eliminated. How about we go back and rest first, and come back tomorrow to finish it off!"
Looking at the gradually extinguishing fire, Taoist Master Four Eyes nodded and asked everyone to go back to the house to rest!
…
"System, hurry up and use your merits to load the second plug-in!"
Lin Daoran returned to the bedroom and rubbed his hands, impatiently urging the system to load the plug-in.
[Merit-, successfully loaded: simplified plug-in with one click]
[One-click simplified plug-in: All exercises, skills, and magical powers can be simplified, allowing you to get rid of the troubles of being a scumbag and experience the pleasure of being a god of learning! Get started quickly and easily improve your proficiency! 】
Lin Daoran looked at the introduction of the simplified plug-in and was dumbfounded. Simplifying the plug-in with just one click was too unreasonable! Learn all the skills and magical powers instantly! Pair it with ten times the training! That is not a perfect skill in one day! All I can say is that I, Lin Daoran, am invincible!
"System, simplify all my magical powers!"
[Simplification successful! 】
[Personal information panel has been updated! 】
Host: Lin Daoran
Talent: Genius
Cultivation level: ninth level of human teacher (4000)
Body Refining: Early Silver Body (100)
Kung Fu: Shangqing Dadong Zhenjing (simplified as: breathing), Maoshan Body Refining Technique (simplified as: moving)
Techniques: Maoshan Talisman (3000 is simplified to: writing), Golden Light Spell (500 is simplified to: sunbathing), Lightning Thunder Fist (500 is simplified to: electric shock), Magical Invocation (4001000 is simplified to: incense)
Supernatural powers: none
Plug-in: Ten times increase in training speed, one-click simplification
